# SIMH's KA10 opcode names, from PDP10/kx10_sys.c (Richard Cornwell, rcornwell/sims),
# opcode[] paired with opc_val[] for the KA build (KL and KS off). Columns: the instruction
# word's high bits in octal, the class (AC: op and AC, OP: AC selects the name, IO: classic
# I/O, the function), and the name. The disassembler's test reads this as its oracle.
